skyStrike.aboutTitle: Sky Strike – Free Online Arcade Shooter Game
skyStrike.aboutP1: Sky Strike is an action-packed arcade shooter played directly in your web browser with no download or installation required. Control your fighter jet, dodge incoming fire, shoot down enemy squadrons to earn points, collect power-ups, and beat your own high score with every run.
skyStrike.aboutP2: On desktop, use the arrow keys, WASD, or your mouse to maneuver. On mobile devices, tap and drag anywhere on the screen to steer. Your aircraft fires automatically, letting you focus entirely on dodging enemy attacks and grabbing power-ups.
skyStrike.aboutP3: Each session lasts just a few minutes, making it ideal for quick gaming breaks. The difficulty scales naturally as you survive longer, keeping the gameplay balanced for beginners while delivering a rewarding challenge for seasoned players.
skyStrike.tutorialLine1: Touch & drag to steer your plane.
skyStrike.tutorialLine2: Your gun fires automatically — just dodge and collect power-ups!
skyStrike.continuePrompt: Watch a short ad to revive right here and keep playing?

bubbleShoot.aboutTitle: Bubble Blast – Free online bubble shooter game
bubbleShoot.aboutP1: Bubble Blast is a classic bubble shooter you can play right in your browser, no download or install needed. Aim and fire colored bubbles to match three or more of the same color, clearing the starry sky before the bubbles reach the bottom.
bubbleShoot.aboutP2: On desktop, move your mouse to aim and click or press Space to shoot. On mobile, drag to aim and release to fire. Every few shots a new row pushes down from the top, so clear the board fast to stay ahead.
bubbleShoot.aboutH2_2: A relaxing pick-up-and-play for any age
bubbleShoot.aboutP3: The controls are simple enough for anyone to pick up, but the rising pressure keeps you coming back for one more round. Each session takes just a few minutes — perfect for a quick break or downtime.

plansVsBugs.game_modalStart_desc: Plant crops, shoot peas, and defend your garden from destructive bugs! Tap a plant card, then tap a garden tile to plant it.
plansVsBugs.game_modalStart_tipDesc: Sunflowers produce Sun — tap dropped suns to gather energy for planting!
plansVsBugs.game_modalTip_desc: Prepare your garden defenses! Total waves:

plansVsBugs.game_modalWin_doubleDesc: Watch an ad to double your level bonus Sun!
plansVsBugs.game_modalLose_desc: Bugs invaded your lawn! Would you like to revive and continue?
plansVsBugs.game_modalLose_reviveDesc: Watch an ad to revive and continue playing!

plansVsBugs.plants_sunflower_desc: Generates Sun every few seconds so you can gather energy to plant more crops.
plansVsBugs.plants_peashooter_desc: Shoots peas to attack oncoming insects in its row.
plansVsBugs.plants_wallnut_desc: Solid defense wall that holds off incoming insects longer.
plansVsBugs.plants_snowpea_desc: Fires frozen peas that deal damage and slow down insects.
plansVsBugs.plants_repeater_desc: Fires two peas at a time for double damage output.
plansVsBugs.plants_cherrybomb_desc: Explodes in an area shortly after planting, instantly defeating nearby insects.
plansVsBugs.plants_melonpult_desc: Lobs melons that deal heavy splash damage around the target.
plansVsBugs.bugs_aphid_fact: Aphids suck plant sap causing leaves to curl and yellow. Ladybugs are their natural predators!
plansVsBugs.bugs_beetle_fact: Beetles have hard protective shells and chew through leaves and roots quickly.
plansVsBugs.bugs_hopper_fact: Grasshoppers move and jump rapidly, capable of clearing entire vegetable patches in a short time.
plansVsBugs.bugs_snail_fact: Snails move slowly but have huge appetites, usually active during damp weather or night.
plansVsBugs.bugs_wasp_fact: Wasps fly overhead and bypass wall defenses — long-range firepower is needed to defeat them.
plansVsBugs.bugs_caterpillar_fact: Caterpillars consume massive amounts of leaves to store energy before pupating.
plansVsBugs.bugs_slugboss_fact: Super durable final boss! Focus all your firepower and use Cherry Bombs to wear it down.
